Hi Ann, 
Thanks for getting back to me. The most common 
blackout material ordered is 
the White. It's completely 
hidden from view once the 
drapes are installed and I 
think one reason it is 
preferred is that it reflects 
the light away from the 
window, etc. The Black 
material also works well but 
since it soaks up the light 
they tend to get very hot if 
they are in front of a large, 
sunny window. 
The blackout effect should be the same regardless of 
which color velour you 
choose for the actual panels. 
The Black velour is popular but there are also other 
darker colors to choose 
from. 
If you go to the page and scroll down a bit you will see the 
different colors available 
for these drapes. So I would 
suggest choosing the color 
you like best since they will 
all be effective in blocking 
out the light.

about two weeks. I would
